name: lyrik
description: Full-screen, word-by-word lyrics with beat-synced edge lights — Windows and Mac
author: Lyrikx

extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: Lyrikx reads the current song from Music or Spotify and controls playback.
extendInfo.NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription: Lyrikx listens to the music playing on your Mac so the edge lights can pulse with the beat.
extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Lyrikx can listen through the microphone so the edge lights pulse with the beat.
